entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: A series of conflicts in northwest Jamuraa between 4195 and 4196 AR stemming from Kaervek's attempts to conquer the region.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A mage allied with malign spirits who conquers Jamuraa, is defeated, and is sealed in the Amber Prison.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A diplomatic mage who creates Mangara's Harmony, is imprisoned in amber, and later frees himself to defeat Kaervek.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A mage who rules an empire of beasts and allies with Kaervek before turning on him.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An ancient Zhalfirin court mage and planeswalker whose experiments with phasing made his isle vanish for two centuries.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: A prophet who foresaw the war and sacrificed herself to free Mangara.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: A leader who forms an elite guard for the rescue mission and dons a dragon mask.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A leader who guides survivors to Tefemburu and helps spring the trap on Kaervek's armies.

entities.name: Hakim Loreweaver
entities.description: The greatest storyteller of Jamuraa, whose dream-born tale makes besiegers vanish at dusk.

entities.name: Sidar Mwigo
entities.description: A Zhalfirin who martyrs herself with her troops at Ufunguo.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, who lands before Asmira and Rashida's party.

entities.name: Purraj
entities.description: A panther warrior left by Kaervek to guard Mangara, believed to have died in the explosion that freed Mangara.

entities.name: Spirit of the Night
entities.description: A terrifying entity that slaughtered the entire Femeref grand assembly.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The kingdom ruled by the Zhalfirin, which splintered and was restored by Teferi and Mangara.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A province that seceded from Zhalfir as an independent state, later invaded by Kaervek.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: An empire that annexed Zhalfir's border lands to mine, later closing its borders.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: The island where Teferi's phasing experiments made it vanish for nearly two hundred years.

entities.name: Tefemburu
entities.description: An overcrowded city destroyed in a trap that annihilated Kaervek's armies.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: A floating city built as a portable tomb for Zhalfir's nobility, controlled by the Shaper and Shadow Creeds.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: The enchanted amber that held Mangara and later sealed Kaervek.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Sisay's flying galleon.

events.summary: Teferi's phasing energy burst makes every plant, animal and building on his isle phase out of existence.
events.quote: The energy unleashed caused every plant, animal, and building on the island to phase out of existence, leaving just bare rock behind.

events.summary: Mangara, Jolrael and Kaervek meet on the barren rock that was Teferi's Isle and settle in Jamuraa.
events.quote: The three mages met on the barren rock that had once been Teferi's Isle.

events.summary: Mangara's diplomacy produces peace agreements between the rival nations.
events.quote: Mangara's gifts for diplomacy and intimidation encouraged peace agreements within a few short years.

events.summary: Kaervek draws the reclusive Jolrael into regional politics and they build covert armies.
events.quote: Slowly, as Mangara's rule took shape, Kaervek was able to draw the reclusive Jolrael into the politics of the region.

events.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael ambush Mangara in the Mwonvuli Delta and imprison him in amber.
events.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed him, capturing him within an Amber Prison that now sits in the throne room of one of Jolrael's palaces.

events.summary: Kaervek reveals himself at the great council and demands the nations' surrender; they defy him.
events.quote: It was then that Kaervek chose to make his appearance, demanding the surrender of the three nations.

events.summary: The Spirit of the Night slaughters the entire Femeref grand assembly.
events.quote: The entire Femeref grand assembly was slaughtered by a terrifying entity known as the Spirit of the Night .

events.summary: Teferi's isle returns and he slays one of Jolrael's dragons.
events.quote: Teferi slew the dragon and immediately set out to discover what was happening

events.summary: Jolrael seeks Teferi's help, but he refuses to intercede and offers dreams and visions instead.
events.quote: Instead, he offered to guide the leaders of Jamuraa through dreams and visions.

events.summary: Kaervek's armies cripple Ufunguo and Sidar Mwigo martyrs herself so citizens can escape.
events.quote: The attack crippled the city; only the martyrdom of Sidar Mwigo and her troops allowed the citizens to escape.

events.summary: Hakim's dream-born tale makes the besiegers vanish at dusk.
events.quote: The tale wove a spell that caused the creatures besieging the city to vanish completely at dusk.

events.summary: A magical trap destroys Tefemburu and Kaervek's armies.
events.quote: The trap sprang - a sphere of crackling energy enclosed Tefemburu and exploded, destroying the city and Kaervek's armies.

events.summary: Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, where Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
events.quote: During the battle, Jolrael turned upon Kaervek, severely injuring the mage in a heated arcane battle.

events.summary: Sisay and the Weatherlight land before Asmira and Rashida's party.
events.quote: Sisay and her flying galleon, the Weatherlight , landed before them.

events.summary: Asmira completes the ritual with her final words, her sacrifice shattering the prison and freeing Mangara.
events.quote: Her sacrifice was accompanied by a blinding shaft of light that shattered the prison, freeing Mangara.

events.summary: Mangara defeats Kaervek and seals him in the Amber Prison.
events.quote: Mangara pinned the mage and sealed him in the Amber Prison.

events.summary: Mangara rebuilds Zhalfir and Femeref after Kaervek's fall.
events.quote: Mangara rebuilt Zhalfir and Femeref, aided by the new trust between the two countries.

relations.note: nations united under his peace against Kaervek
relations.quote: United against a common foe, the nations of Jamuraa flatly defied Kaervek
